text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: realtime alert: p99 latency spike for model=redwood/vicuna-13b-quant in region=us-west1. p95 -> 1.4s, p99 -> 6.8s, error rate +0.3%. Alert rule: realtime_latency_p99 > 3s for 2m. Paginate: samir (sre-oncall)

samir (sre-oncall): acked. I'm on it. grabbing dashboards now. paging oncall-platform and observability.

marco (observability): looking — traces show tailness on streaming responses, a large fraction of tokens stalling around step=kv-fetch. Link: https://dashboards/redwood/latency?range=5m (posted)

ingrid (platform-oncall): I see a queue backlog on vicuna-usw-pool-2, pods at 95% GPU mem. Could be batching/kvcache pressure.

laila (prod-eng): any customer-facing errors? support-bot, any incoming tickets?

support-bot: Two support threads opened in last 4m: ticket #6421 from AcmeCorp: timeouts on streaming; #6422 from NovaPay: slow responses. Both on us-west1.

samir (sre-oncall): ok mitigation plan: 1) enable canary fallback to smaller model (rw:model-redwood/mistral-7b-quant) for new requests, 2) scale vicuna-usw-pool +3 replicas, 3) temporarily reduce streaming max_tokens to 512 for us-west. Doing 2/3 now.

ingrid (platform-oncall): running scale command now:
```
# increase dedicated pool replicas
rwctl pool scale --name vicuna-usw-pool --replicas +3 --region us-west1
kubectl get pods -l app=vicuna-usw -o wide
```
output: 3 new pods scheduled, one pod in CrashLoopBackoff -> investigating image/kernel mismatch on node gpu-12.

marco (observability): quick dashboard checks: tail latency bucket with req_size>1024 tokens spiked x4; streaming stall trace sample:
```
span: streaming-handler -> kv-cache-get (duration 2.3s)
span: token-gen (wait) -> kernel-sched (queued 1.1s)
```
Possible root causes: kernel update on subset of nodes or NVLink topology degradation.

laila (prod-eng): can we route traffic away from the problematic pool to healthy pools/regions? We should avoid global failover unless required.

samir (sre-oncall): temporarily pin routing policy: route us-west1 -> vicuna-usw-pool-healthy and canary to mistral-7b-quant. Applying policy change:
```
rwctl routing apply --region us-west1 --policy override --from vicuna-usw-pool --to vicuna-usw-pool-healthy,mistral-7b-quant:20%
```
Applied. Observability: watch p95/p99.

marco (observability): after routing change p95 dropped to 800ms within 45s, p99 trending down to ~2.1s. error rate stable.

ingrid (platform-oncall): node gpu-12 shows kernel mismatch from recent infra patch; isolating node and cordoning. Draining affected pods.

samir (sre-oncall): good. customer impact: AcmeCorp reported ~4% requests timed out; NovaPay partial slowdowns. Support teams informed. jen (solutions) — want to add callers for high-touch customers?

jen (solutions): on it, I'll open a private status and ping AcmeCorp/SecOps with temporary mitigation details.

laila (prod-eng): next steps for remediation: 1) revert infra patch or reconcile kernel on gpu-12, 2) ensure automatic fallback to smaller model for long streams, 3) postmortem and SLA check.

samir (sre-oncall): setting severity P2 for now (wider customer impact but mitigated). Creating incident ticket: INC-2026-4523. Assigning to platform and infra. Handoff: I need to step out in ~20m; ingrid will take primary. @ingrid please acknowledge when you have comfortable ops state.

ingrid (platform-oncall): ack. taking over monitoring and will coordinate infra rollback if needed. scheduling a quick huddle in #inc-huddle in 5.

marco (observability): I'll keep alerts muted to avoid noise and post regular p95/p99 updates every 5m here. Next update in ~5m.

support-bot: Customer notifications queued: AcmeCorp (private link), NovaPay (email).

samir (sre-oncall): thanks team. summary of live mitigations performed: scaled pool +3, cordoned faulty node, applied routing override with mistral-7b canary (20%), reduced streaming max_tokens to 512, support notified. Monitoring continuing. :thumbsup:

jen (solutions): noted. I'll coordinate account-level debriefs after incident is closed.

marco (observability): update 5m: p95=780ms, p99=1.9s, error rate back to baseline. Keeping watch for 30m.

ingrid (platform-oncall): ongoing — preparing kernel-reconcile playbook, will propose patch rollback in change window if impact persists.

samir (sre-oncall): handing to ingrid for next 30m. I'll post final handoff note in 15m with any new findings.

ingrid (platform-oncall): ack and taking over. :eyes:
